notes.title: THE WALKING EVIL to exit early access today.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36466335/d16b7e2497b384f5fcc6fb4e2238eda05af30cf8.jpg[/img]
THE WALKING EVIL to exit early access today.
Update V 1.3

- Now the plot for Chloe is easier.
- Fixed a bug with which it was possible to duplicate cartridges in the chest.
- The camera is configured, there are no more problems with the camera near the walls during aiming.
- The arena has stabilized lighting.
- Fixed animation for Chloe when she holds a gun.
- Fixed increase in walking speed, running.
- Change of run / walk now through SHIFT.
- Fixed picture in the room.
- Configured camera and fixed camera controls.
- The combat with a knife has been facilitated, now all zombies recline, including lying ones.
- Increased HP zombies by 35 units, at all difficulty levels.
- Increased werewolf HP by 60 units, at all difficulty levels.
- Knife damage reduced from 30 points to 26.
- 2 new zombie flipping animations.
- Now some zombies can be killed with a fatal blow, by pressing the "E" button.
- Added a purple first aid kit at the beginning of the game, it lies in the basement.
- The yellow first aid kit is removed from the attic.
- Added HP Regeneration for Werewolves.
- Added the sound of footsteps for a zombie cop.
- Approaching the camera while aiming.
- Moved the phone to record at the end of the game.
- Fixed a bug with displaying weapons during interaction.
- Added 2 control mods to choose from. The choice is made on the button "8" in the game.
- Added partial gamepad support. (However, it is in beta).
- When the enemy blocks near the wall, it is now easier to kill the enemy.
- The sight is now more accurate, but with fast shooting the spread of the cartridge increases.

notes.title: Update V 1.205
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36466335/055eb19b2e1627b283463d6b55e861a3cf74c09b.png[/img]

1) The gun is now visible on the floor at the beginning of the game.
2) Now it is impossible to die while watching the cutscene.
3) The problem is solved when watching a cutscene with a corpse of a policeman.
4) Fixed a collision near the fountain and on the balcony against the wall.
5) Fixed a collision in the first save room.
6) Fixed a bug with achievement a medal, now 2 medals at the very end of the game.

notes.title: Update V 1.205
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36466335/01b127c64caab16b214f5c987b7b89a19b70d51e.jpg[/img]

Fixed bug with the map.
The door to the dining room is clogged with boards.
Fixed sounds of zombies.

notes.title: Update V 1.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36466335/01b127c64caab16b214f5c987b7b89a19b70d51e.jpg[/img]

1) An icon has been added to the code lock in the basement.
2) The puzzle with the clock has become more understandable.
3) The cameras in the office are shot.
4) The door to the office has been improved.
5) At the very beginning of the game, management tips were added.
6) Slowing down time when opening inventory.
7) Now the card opens on M and closes on M.
8) The chandelier in the air in the library was removed.
9) The sound volume of the zombies is reduced. Now it is more realistic.
10) Added an additional zombie sound.
11) Added the sound of zombie steps.
12) The sound of rain is reduced by 20%.
13) The sound on the TV is now realistic.
14) Added sound when the zombie head exploded.
15) Added female voice for zombies.
16) Replaced the knife model.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36466335/055eb19b2e1627b283463d6b55e861a3cf74c09b.png[/img]

1) Car grip improved by 50%
2) The car has improved brakes by 35%
3) Added an entry-level restart button with the machine. Now you do not need to replay from the beginning.
4) Fixed code lock in the basement.
5) The map in the mansion is fixed, the door is added.
6) Fixed a barrel in the boiler room.
7) Added 22 additional shotgun cartridges.
8) Added 4 additional pistol cartridges.
9) Added 15 additional cartridge rifle.
9) Hits  knife, blood is added.
10) Now you can beat the lying zombies with a knife, but it’s still difficult to kill them.
11) Added dismemberment.
12) Reduced the amount of health in the final boss.

notes.title: Update 1.015
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36466335/e7395b78b1ef8f5658e32d47c306d3d542fe6927.jpg[/img]

Fixed freezes during cut scenes, more understandable puzzles. No more black screen during cutscenes.

notes.title: Update 1.005

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36466335/b85d4b46502d4cd2d13accfb466ba5c0b025b8e1.jpg[/img]
Fixed initial splash screen.
In the office and mansion, lighting is increased by 50%
